##### Project general facts

The Wilds Residences by Aldar is a nature-led apartment collection designed to restore balance, nurture wellbeing and connect residents with the natural world. Six residential buildings rise from a ground floor to ten, twelve and fifteen residential floors, balancing privacy and openness through architecture that keeps nature always in view. The collection offers one- and two-bedroom apartments, three-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, and spacious two- and three-bedroom duplexes for families.

Amenities flow seamlessly through the landscape. Residents enjoy nature-inspired pools, a gym and spa facilities, a jogging track, a cinema room and a brewing lounge, together with a creative studio, kids' and teens' lounges and discovery and adventure play areas. Trails wind through the community to the central park with its meditation decks, fitness zones, The Nest pavilion, stargazing and bird watching points and tennis and padel courts, while retail outlets add everyday convenience.

Interiors reflect an elegant harmony between refined living and organic inspiration. Homes are bathed in natural light and finished with premium materials, offering a choice of light or dark palettes inspired by the landscape. Kitchens feature engineered stone countertops, contemporary cabinetry and porcelain finishes, while bathrooms are appointed with quality fixtures. Generous balconies extend living areas outdoors, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Wadi Al Safa is a green residential district in the south of Dubai, neighbouring Majan and the green neighbourhoods of Al Barari. Nature trails, native landscaped gardens, a central park, natural pools and streams and themed gardens shape a calm setting where native wildlife thrives, while community retail and a world-class school serve families close to home and create a peaceful setting away from busy city streets.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road runs alongside the community, providing quick access across the city. IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village and Hamdan Sports Complex are a short drive away, while Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall, Business Bay, Dubai International Airport and Dubai Marina are within comfortable driving distance, together with Dubai Hills and Arabian Ranches, keeping shopping, dining and leisure within easy reach.

Wadi Al Safa offers freehold communities designed to LEED and Fitwel standards, offering a rare combination of biophilic design, privacy and central connectivity. Nature-focused communities with generous open spaces are in limited supply in Dubai, supporting strong demand from families and end users. The backing of a leading developer and a growing lifestyle offer underpin long-term value for owners and investors.
